title: Japan Ke 3 Paise Wale Tarike
note:
THE DEBUNK. Where the surplus actually goes, and why the saving story
     was never about culture. The arc runs neutral paper -> amber under
     examination -> red at the falsity -> amber deepening -> the coldest read
     on the half nobody shows -> red hot at the peak that collapsed -> neutral
     paper for the five real reasons -> green on the honest line.

     Archetypes: A B A B B A A D B A D A. B is HELD across s25/s26 because
     51.0% and 11.5%/41.5% are one argument (what Japan holds, and what it
     does not) — the layout stays put while the mechanism changes under it.

     Four scenes keep a drawn layer; the other eight are art-off, because a
     drawn safe over a photograph of safes, a drawn peak over a photographed
     peak graph and a drawn page over a photographed page are all depictive,
     not additive (rule 8). What survives asserts something no photograph can:
     a 90/3 split, 51% of a whole, a 25-year window inside eight decades, and
     a count of five.

s22.comment:
3.1 · A · PLATE · no role · neutral warm — the chapter opens off ch2's warm
     resolve. A bank facade; nothing drawn belongs on it.

s23.comment:
3.2 · B · FIGURE · target · amber — WHERE IT LANDS. The photograph is a form
     being filled at a counter; it cannot say 90 against 3. The drawn layer is
     exactly that and nothing else: one track, the surplus split to scale, the
     securities sliver deliberately almost too small to see arrive.

s24.comment:
3.3 · A · PLATE · warn · red — SAVING IS NOT INVESTING. The scene already
     carries the padlock icon in its stack, verbatim; a second drawn layer over
     a photograph of closed lockers would only repeat the picture.

s25.comment:
3.4 · B · FIGURE · target · amber — 51.0%. The measure bar is the additive
     half: the figure says 51.0%, the bar says HALF OF EVERYTHING THEY HOLD,
     before the number is read. Two real framings, a second photograph at
     +5.200, both verbatim.

s26.comment:
3.5 · B · FIGURE · target · amber deeper — HELD on B. Same table, next
     column, so the same layout with a different mechanism: two tracks at the
     same scale, cash against equity, which is the comparison the line makes and
     the one the photograph of a printed page cannot.

s27.comment:
3.6 · A · PLATE · no role · cool — THE HALF NOBODY SHOWS. The chapter's
     quietest frame and its coolest so far; the clay pot carries it alone.

s28.comment:
3.7 · A · PLATE · warn · red — the Showa street. A period photograph is the
     whole argument here; nothing drawn can add to "was not always".

s29.comment:
3.8 · D · BAND · target · amber — THE HIGH-SAVING ERA. The band gets the
     mechanism: eight postwar decades as one rule, with 1961-1986 lit inside it.
     The photograph is a calendar page of printed years; what it cannot say is
     how SMALL twenty-five years is against the span it sits in.

s30.comment:
3.9 · B · FIGURE · warn · red hot — 23.2%, the peak that collapsed. The
     photograph is already a hand-drawn peak on graph paper, so a drawn peak on
     top of it is the textbook depictive failure. Art off; the figure carries it.

s31.comment:
3.10 · A · PLATE · warn · red — NOT CULTURE. The quote sits on a photograph
     of the paper it comes from. A drawn page over a photographed page is the
     same mistake as a drawn seal over a government building.

s32.comment:
3.11 · D · BAND · no role · neutral paper — THE ACTUAL REASONS. Five, and
     the count is the point: not one cause, five separate ones. Five tally
     strokes land under the enumeration, off-level and hand-weighted, the same
     hand as ch2's tick. Two real framings, second photograph at +5.000.
